WITH d2001 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
cd1_f AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
cust_birth AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_birth_year, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
),
cd2_match AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_demo_sk IN (SELECT c_current_cdemo_sk FROM cust_birth)
),
addr_states AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
),
cust_addr_base AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, a.ca_country, a.ca_state, a.ca_county
    FROM addr_states a
    JOIN cust_birth c ON c.c_current_addr_sk = a.ca_address_sk
    JOIN cd2_match cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
),
sales_preagg AS (
    SELECT
        s.cs_item_sk,
        s.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        s.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_all,
        SUM(CAST(s.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS sum_qty,
        COUNT(s.cs_quantity) AS cnt_qty,
        SUM(CAST(s.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS sum_list,
        COUNT(s.cs_list_price) AS cnt_list,
        SUM(CAST(s.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS sum_coupon,
        COUNT(s.cs_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon,
        SUM(CAST(s.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS sum_sales_price,
        COUNT(s.cs_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price,
        SUM(CAST(s.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS sum_profit,
        COUNT(s.cs_net_profit) AS cnt_profit
    FROM catalog_sales s
    JOIN d2001 d ON s.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY s.cs_item_sk, s.cs_bill_customer_sk, s.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    cab.ca_country,
    cab.ca_state,
    cab.ca_county,
    SUM(p.sum_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(p.cnt_qty), 0) AS agg1,
    SUM(p.sum_list) / NULLIF(SUM(p.cnt_list), 0) AS agg2,
    SUM(p.sum_coupon) / NULLIF(SUM(p.cnt_coupon), 0) AS agg3,
    SUM(p.sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(p.cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4,
    SUM(p.sum_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(p.cnt_profit), 0) AS agg5,
    SUM(CAST(cab.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * p.cnt_all) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cab.c_birth_year IS NOT NULL THEN p.cnt_all ELSE 0 END), 0) AS agg6,
    SUM(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * p.cnt_all) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd1.cd_dep_count IS NOT NULL THEN p.cnt_all ELSE 0 END), 0) AS agg7
FROM cust_addr_base cab
JOIN sales_preagg p ON cab.c_customer_sk = p.cs_bill_customer_sk
JOIN cd1_f cd1 ON p.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN item i ON p.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, cab.ca_country, cab.ca_state, cab.ca_county)
ORDER BY cab.ca_country, cab.ca_state, cab.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
